honesty: door_open=UNKNOWN is kept as its own state and never renamed CLOSED
an unattested segment is named *_AS_REPORTED, never OPEN or CLOSED: a reading is not a state until a per-boot attestation says it is
an incidental OPEN window inside a commissioning stage is not an S2 pilot event
thermal rise is measured on chamber-air slots; TEC_HOT_SIDE is reported separately
a host fixture returns events, and every one of them says so

mc38_alignment_cross_check.meaning: MC-38 transitions are the machine ground truth only if the device's own cycle counter agrees with the detected edge count; a mismatch means an edge was missed

polarity_inversion.conclusion: no frames carry both door_raw and a confirmed polarity

contact_inversion.action_required: the H8 bench owner must commit the driver source
contact_inversion.assertion_basis: docs/01 §8.1 (door semantics are subject to the actual polarity mapping) and §8.2 (neither HIGH=OPEN nor LOW=OPEN may be assumed without physical verification), plus the mapping table this module carries
contact_inversion.claim: the two shipped polarity settings assign opposite door states to every raw level, so a capture cannot establish its own door narrative
contact_inversion.closes_when: the owning branch commits the door driver, after which the inversion is verifiable from tracked source
contact_inversion.why_not_citable: that file is not git-tracked on any ref in this repository; it exists only in a sibling working tree, so it may not be quoted as the proof of a published claim

timing.cross_check: sum of detected OPEN->CLOSED transitions must equal the device's final door_cycles; a mismatch means the capture missed an edge and the pilot run is not usable
timing.note: a 50 ms debounce on a 10 ms poll is far inside one telemetry interval, so the machine ground truth is quantised by the 1 Hz frame stream, not by the sensor; an operator timer remains the only sub-second check (docs/05A §19 A-W10-02)
